text: dsh-approval-diff 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件，在原生文件变更审批卡中加入 diff 详情。它通过 conversation.approval.detail 展示待审批的 edit 和 write 改动，并可呈现删除命令提示；文件上下文由宿主本地路由读取，帮助用户查看变更再作决定。需要 DeepSeek Harness 与 dsh-diff-view 组件，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-approval-diff adds diff details to DSH Web approval cards via conversation.approval.detail. It shows pending edit and write changes, plus deletion notices. A host route supplies file context for review. It requires DeepSeek Harness and dsh-diff-view; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 的文件审批请求里直接查看差异内容。
让文件修改审批显示带上下文的行级 diff。
I want readable diffs in DSH file change approval cards.
dsh-approval-diff 的功能「审批卡 diff 预览」：在原生审批卡详情位呈现文件 edit 和 write 的改动，并提供 split 与 unified 视图切换。
dsh-approval-diff 的功能「文件上下文」：浏览器请求宿主的上下文路由读取目标文本，以磁盘内容为改动添加行号和周边上下文；内容不可读时仍可显示未编号的差异。

dsh-approval-diff README · dsh-approval-diff：<!-- pending-surface test marker (safe to revert) -->
A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin: install it into a profile alongside your own plugins.

dsh-approval-diff README · dsh-approval-diff：**See what you approve.** When the model asks permission to change a file, the
native card shows the tool arguments: `old_string` and `new_string` as raw
text, no file context, no line numbers. This plugin replaces that ask with a
real diff review: red and green lines side by side, word-level highlights
inside changed lines, surrounding file content with true line numbers, and
exactly two buttons.

dsh-approval-diff README · Plugin value proposition： | alternative | falls short | |---|---| | the native approval card | raw tool arguments; you reconstruct the diff in your head, every ask | | reading the file yourself | you become the diff engine, and the model already read it once | | auto-approve and hope | no review at all |

dsh-approval-diff README · What you get：- The pending `edit` rendered as a real diff INSIDE the native approval
  card, through the card's own `conversation.approval.detail` seat: disk-
  anchored line numbers, a context window around the change, and word-level
  highlights (via [dsh-diff-view](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-diff-view))
- Split or Unified views (GitHub-style toggle, choice remembered); split
  pairs removals left with additions right, unified groups each change run
  as all removed lines then all added
- `write` shows the new content as additions, merged against the current
  file when one exists; deletion commands (`rm` and friends) render a
  review notice so the command text gets read before allowing
- The diff is anchored to DISK TRUTH fetched at ask time from this
  package's host route; when the file cannot be read, the operands still
  render as an aligned diff with blank numbers, never lying numbers
- Stale-operand warning: when the edit's old text is no longer in the file,
  the card says so instead of showing a diff that cannot apply
- QUEUED SAME-FILE EDITS ARE ONE REVIEW: every pending (unsettled) edit to
  the same file that the model has alr

dsh-approval-diff README · How to install：Requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout and a profile, here `web`. Clone the
plugin into a plugins folder:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/dsh-plugins && cd ~/dsh-plugins
git clone https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-approval-diff.git
dsh-approval-diff README · from the harness checkout：pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-approval-diff

dsh-approval-diff README · verify the profile still composes：pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart the harness after installing: the host half loads at boot. The
client half hot-reloads once installed.

dsh-approval-diff README · Limitations：- File-changing approvals only (`edit`, `write`, deletion-only `bash`).
  Everything else renders no detail and stays fully native.
- Deletion review shows the command text, not the deleted content.
- Requires dsh 0.1.2+ (the pending-interaction approval model). The v0.20
  composer takeover and its per-card buttons are retired: the native card
  owns the chrome and the buttons. Approvals arrive one at a time (the
  session queues them internally); arming replaces the old batch decision
  workflow for repeated edits to the same file.

dsh-approval-diff README · Dependencies：- [dsh-diff-view](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-diff-view) owns the diff engine and stylesheet this plugin renders its review cards with (required; the plugin does not activate without it)
